batting.dismissal: c JM Sharma b JR Hazlewood

batting.name: F du Plessis
batting.dismissal: c V Kohli b KH Pandya

batting.name: KK Nair
batting.dismissal: c B Kumar b Yash Dayal

batting.name: KL Rahul
batting.dismissal: c JG Bethell b B Kumar

batting.name: T Stubbs
batting.dismissal: c JR Hazlewood b B Kumar

batting.name: JG Bethell
batting.dismissal: c KK Nair b AR Patel

batting.name: V Kohli
batting.dismissal: c MA Starc b PVD Chameera

balls.text: 122.6kmh, really wide outside off, Chameera had shuffled towards off before swinging wildly against it. He misses and then reviews for a wide that wasn't called. Third umpire says he can see "some portion of the ball" inside the revised wide line outside off so it's not a wide. So a dot to end the innings and just six from this over
135.1kmh, miscues the drive down completely with the change of pace and he skies it to point. Hazlewood gets his bucket hands under it easily
124.5kmh, not a lot of pace but he gets some distance with that pull square of the wicket. A couple of bounces and that crosses the rope before a fielder can get to it
slow and dug into the pitch outside off, tries the reverse paddle but misses

gone at the non-striker's end! He lofts the full delivery over the bowler and they decide to go for the second. No way there was a second there, so Nigam falls well short, but they get one and Stubbs keep strike
116.6kmh, he across to off to paddle it fine but misses. Manages a leg bye to the leg side

four to end the over down the ground! Stubbs is turning things on here. A slow attempted yorker, Stubbs uses his wide stance to pack some power into that and sends it crashing back along the carpet to beat the fielders in the deep
finally gets one in the block hole, he sticks to his guns, and beats Stubbs outside off

reverse scooped this time, goes all the way! We have a crowd here, I just realised, and they're waving those flags. Low full toss on middle and leg, Stubbs was prepared for that and he reverses his bat to middle that away fine on the off side. Stunning shot
134.6kmh, nearly in the block hole and that's another full ball drilled back by Stubbs, past the bowler for four

chaos at the Kotla! Driven to cover and Stubbs takes off, he's sent back, Patidar has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end and misses. The ball runs away to Kohli at the other side of the ground and he misfields for a change, gone past him for four
nails the yorker to end the over, some reverse swing as well to tail that in, and Stubbs digs it out

a near-yorker lofted straight back beautifully for a one-bounce four! He errs with the length just a bit, Hazlewood, and Stubbs, who had started the over with a scoop, resorts to classical straight drive straight back over the bowler
stays still and watches the wide yorker go well outside off for a wide
nearly a yorker, a really low full toss and he drives to cover for one. Really quick single because if the stumps were hit at the bowler's end, he was gone

ramped for six! Short and into the pitch around off, Nigam is already standing outside leg and he waits for the ball till the last second before sticking his bat out with perfect timing to send that sailing over the fielder in the deep
136.3kmh, full toss with some pace on it, flicked down to long on and he wans two but they decide against it
scoops that deftly, short fine leg in the circle and he's got enough bat on that to beat Dayal for four
a similar delivery to Nigam first ball, he carefully blocks with a straight bat

bamboozled! The impact sub lasts three balls. At 124.3kmh was that slow legcutter, pitching in line with the stumps and Ashutosh thought he could place it behind square but he was done with his shot, shower and shave before the ball reached him and hit leg stump
he pokes again, this time connects and gets a single thanks to a fumble from point
he gets a short of length ball first up and he pokes and misses
there comes the big shot straightaway against pace and he's gone! Pitched up, scrambled seam, he swings down the ground but doesn't quite get the distance and Bethell dives forward for an easy catch
132.9kmh, nearly in the block hole on off, gently driven down to long off for one
short on off, pulled into the gap on leg wide of long-on and two more to end the over
softs hands to place this square of the wicket and the fielders are all in the deep, so they have time for the second
a bit slower on leg, some drift, and nudged to leg for one
too short, there comes an attacking stroke but he's pulled that straight to deep midwicket for one
on Rahul's pads this time with the angle from around the wicket, he clips it away for two
fired into the pads, quite a bit down leg and clipped away for one
tossed up nicely for the first time this over, and Stubbs whips it against the turn for another single
flat on middle to Rahul and he whips it away to wide long on for another single
flat on leg without turn, Stubbs clips it square off the back foot for one
he comes down this time and Suyash smartly pitches it well down leg so he can't hit it away, single to long on
full and flat on the stumps as he makes room again, can't clear cover with his drive this time
backs away early, Suyash follows him with a full toss on he pads and Rahul can only tap it back
second full toss in the over, on Rahul's pads and it's flicked away for one

oh, bravado! He drives the ball pitched up on off to mid-off and he wants to get off the mark immediately. Has to put in a dive to make it at the bowler's end although there was no direct hit. But direct hit and he was gone, just saw on the replay

takes away middle stump! It's flat on the ground. You just can't keep this man out of the game in any phase. Good length and towards middle stump, Axar swings across the line and does't connect at all
a full toss, perhaps Axar didn't expect it and he gently taps it down to mid off
he backs away early, Hazlewood bangs it into the pitch but takes the pace off and Rahul can only pull it away to deep midwicket. Reaches him after a bounce
swept for four! That was almost a sweep, not quite the orthodox one. He goes low for the cross-seam delivery on the stumps and tucks it behind square on the leg side for four
flatter on off now and he punches it towards extra cover for one
misses the sweep. Floated on middle and he gets good turn to beat the sweeping bat and just misses off! Bowled it quite slow as well
on middle and leg, helps it along with the spin to leg for one
drifting in towards the pads, nudges it to leg easily for one more
woah, a bouncer at 116.9kmh! That came out of nowhere - banged into the pitch and Axar is taken by surprise but he manages some bat off the hook for one
welcome back, Krunal! Axar trie to go big against Suyash too, but this ball is much closer to him and he swings with the turn, from middle stump line, all the way over midwicket into the crowd
short and turning in again, pushes it down to long on for one
poor delivery - it's short down leg and turning down further, Axar stays still and helps it long with half a scoop well side of short fine leg for four
swings for the hills down the ground but he's beaten completely outside off
tight on the middle stump,  he works it to leg to pinch a single
some width and a bit short despite the turn, he punches off the back foot into the off side
turning in nicely towards middle and leg, he blocks it back
Gets this past the fielder! Length ball angled across, Rahul drives with the open face and it just beats the backward point fielder's dive to his right. Much needed boundary for DC
Full outside off, clipped to long-on off the inside half of the bat
On a length outside off, punched to cover
Full around off, slower ball, Rahul hammers a drive to long-off
On a length around leg and finishing on off, Rahul blocks it back towards the bowler
Full around off, Rahul creams a drive straight down the ground but Tim David at long-on hurries across and saves the boundary
On a length outside off, Axar punches it to Krunal's right and they can't get the single away

Faf's struggles come to an end! This is tossed up full on leg and du Plessis clears his front leg and looks to hit it down the ground. Comes off the inside half of the bat and goes straight to Virat Kohli, who makes no mistake and pumps his fist as his opening partner for the last three years walks back to the dugout
Tossed up full on leg, Rahul brings out the sweep but this is straight to deep square leg
Rahul backs away to this length ball that comes in with the angle. Looks to whip it leg side, but misses. Wry smile from Rahul
On a length on middle and coming in with the angle. Faf backs away and whips it to long-on's right
Floated up outside off, it spins away and Rahul adjusts late to drive it out to deep point
Length ball outside off, fizzed in at 100kph, pushed out to backward point
Length ball on off, worked to long-on's right
Overpitched on leg and Rahul is onto it in a hurry. Gets low and sweeps this hard behind square leg. Fielder in the deep had no chance
Legbreak on a length outside off, punched to cover
Rahul looks to slog-sweep but this full back-of-hand delivery outside off stays low to beat the bat!
On a length on off, he hangs back and works it down the ground to long-on
On a length outside off, du Plessis waits on it and punches it out to deep point
ON a length on middle, he goes back and punches it out to long-on
Du Plessis looks to flick away this length delivery on leg but manages an inside edge to short fine
On a length around middle and leg, Faf backs away and tucks it through the vacant midwicket region. They comfortably get two
Full on leg, played back to the bowler
Tossed up on off, Rahul paddles it through fine leg for a single
On a length around off, Rahul pulls it down the ground to long-on
Tucked out to deep square leg

On a length on the stumps, Rahul backs away and punches this back down the ground, Suyash goes across to stop it but gets in a tangle with Faf du Plessis and the ball evades him and allows the single. The bowler isn't happy with that but nothing doing
Googly outside off, punched out to deep point
Tossed full around off, driven out to deep point
Has he tickled that down leg? Jitesh is excited, so is Kohli. They don't review. That likely went off the pad, and the replay confirms it
Great comeback from Hazlewood. Beats him with a beauty. On a length outside off and it straightens just enough to beat the outside edge as du Plessis looks to cover drive
That's more like it from Faf! Overpitched outside off and du Plessis lofts it back over the bowler's head. And that takes DC past fifty
Full on the stumps, Rahul flicks it between midwicket and mid-on, but can't beat mid-on running to his left and putting in the dive. Good work from the RCB skipper there
Bouncer outside off, 130kph, Rahul shapes to pull but doesn't offer a shot in the end
On a length around off, tucked to midwicket
Short ball outside off, Rahul pulls it along the ground to deep midwicket for a brace
Rahul pushes this length ball angled across him towards mid-off and takes the single on offer
On a length on leg, still some movement away from the right-hander, and Rahul punches it down to mid-on

Skies it and it's taken! Short ball angled across, Nair looks to pull it away but is a bit cramped for room. Top edge goes high in the night sky and Bhuvneshwar Kumar makes no mistake. RCB keep getting powerplay wickets
On a length on leg, fended to cover's left
Goes for the wide yorker again and du Plessis just manages to drive it out to deep point
Dayal goes for the wide yorker but overdoes the line

He finally gets one away! Not the most convincing of shots, but he gets enough of that. Short around leg and du Plessis gives charge and pulls it away in front of square. Not of the middle, but it does the job. And Dayal has overstepped!
Back of length and angled across, he looks to pull and gets it off the inside half towards midwicket. Pressure building on du Plessis
Clears the midwicket fielder with the pull! Short around off and Nair plays a short-arm jab to midwicket's right. Placed it well enough and got enough elevation on that
Full around off, driven to mid-on

Hazlewood ends Porel's march! He's strangled down leg! Short down leg, Porel looks to swivel and pull and only gloves it behind. Jitesh takes it diving to his right and the finger goes up immediately. Porel doesn't bother with a review and Hazlewood takes the lead in the Purple Cap race!
Short of good length around leg, 136kph, Porel swivels to pull and misses it altogether. Cops a blow on his hips
Back of length outside off, pulled to mid-on's right and they take a tight single. The throw was close at the non-striker's end
On a length outside off, du Plessis defends as it seams in
Full on leg, Porel flicks it fine on the leg side and Bethell at deep backward square makes his way across to keep it down to two
Helped over fine leg! Length ball down leg and Porel plays that pick-up shot to perfection. Porel has got a move on now

Length ball slapped away behind point. Shepherd at deep backward point dives to try and stop, but he was rolling around and may have hit the rope. The umpire is convinced that Shepherd hasn't touched the boundary at all. Excellent balance from him! My word.

Just clears the fielder! Excellent attempt from Bethell, but he can't stop that. This is full around middle and Porel skips out and swings it leg side. The bottom hand came off as the ball went high in the air in front of square. Bethell, running to his left, puts in the dive but DC get their first six
Slower ball outside off, run down to deep third for a single

On a length around off, du Plessis skips out and blocks it towards point. Immediately tells Porel that there's no run in there. As if to add emphasis, Kohli nails a direct hit at the non-striker's end

Heaved across the line! This is full around off and Porel muscles it along the ground in front of square leg. This one races away. It was an excellent over until this ball but Porel manages to finish it well for Delhi
Length ball around off, seaming in, Porel tucks it square on the leg side and the midwicket fielder gives chase. They get two
Full just outside off, du Plessis pushes it down to mid-off for a quick run
Beaten! On a length on middle, quite a bit of swing away from du Plessis, who comes down the track and prods at it only to see the ball fly past the outside edge
Full outside off, du Plessis backs away while coming out of his crease and laces a drive to mid-off
On a length around middle and off, punched square to Kohli's left at cover point and he's onto it in a flash
On a length around off, du Plessis opens the face to steer it square on the off side
Back of length outside off, seaming in, Porel looks to pull it away and gets an inside edge out to deep backward square
Full around off, swinging away, tapped through point and du Plessis is off the mark
On a length and wide of off, swinging away as well, Faf shoulders arms
Length ball angled across, Porel pushes at it and gets an inside edge onto his pads. The ball rolls square on the off side and they get the leg bye. Better from Bhuvi
Starts off with a poor delivery and Porel cashes in. This is full on leg, hint of swing in, and Porel clips it in the vacant fine leg area

finished with another four and RCB have become the first team in IPL history to win their first six away games on the bounce! Mukesh went for the yorker on middle stump this time and David was deep in his crease, late it come to him and flicked it away to the fine leg boundary
carved through the point boundary, four more and this is almost over, folks. Aims for the yorker, David has some width to work with and he uses that to bash it away

an easier full toss to smash and that's smacked for four! Waist high full toss, David swivels on his back foot while going through the shot, and gets a one-bounce four to square leg. They will check for the height of that full toss, RCB have asked for a review. By the barest of margins - waist height is 1.02m and the ball is t 1.03. So no ball given
the first is a low full toss and David is not leaving that one! Swings it straight back, over the bowler's head with some power and it goes all the way
swings wildly against that fullish ball, gets only the inside half to leg for one

really well-judged catch from Starc at long off! Slow legcutter well outside off, Kohli might think he has enough to send this for six, and it's sailing away, but Starc has his eyes glued to it while he goes to his left, stays just inside the rope and gobbles it nicely
Chameera aims for the shoes and nails it, Krunal awkwardly flicks it away behind square with some bat on it
similar near-yorker to Kohli outside off and he too scythes it away square for one more. This is in their bag now
aims for the yorker outside off, Krunal carves it wide of point for one

Krunal, go buy a lottery ticket! Smashes this in the air to mid off and the ball goes through mid off. Stubbs goes to his left, puts in a slide and sees the ball land in front of him and then go through for four

starts with a wide yorker well outside off, not given a wide and RCB review it. Krunal didn't move from his stance and the ball is juuust towards the outer side of the thick tram line, so changed to a wide
aims for the yorker again, and this time it's a single down to long on. He keeps strike
carved on the off side this time, for more! In the block hole inches from the off stump but Krunal is feeling so good now, he middles that scythe wide of the diving point fielder

flicked off the toes for four in the gap, the crowd loves it! It's the flamingo flick because Krunal also wants to protect his front toe if he misses, but he's absolutely middled that to the midwicket boundary. Kohli gives him a pat on the helmet
skied on the off side, cover is running back but it's out of his reach! More luck for Krunal. Axar kept his eyes on the ball and kept running back but no way he was getting under that. Two more
fifty for Kohli now as he flicks the full toss on the pads to short fine leg and the crowd from his city gives him a big applause
starts with a low full toss around off, pushed back to him

short ball pulled away in the air, deep midwicket comes in and drops it! Abishek Porel is the fielder who is now watching in disbelief while Starc cries for the ball to be thrown back. Starc wants to take the bails off once the ball is returned to him, but it slips out and goes away past the stumps, and they leak one more
wide outside off, he wants to nail a wide yorker but it's a low full toss but Kohli can't get more than a single for the drive
backs away again, it's full this time on his toes and he flicks it away over midwicket. Two more easily
banged in short, not much bounce so it's not into the rib cage and Kohli pulls it away behind square by using the angle. Four in the gap
a misfield at cover after Krunal drives the full ball there with hard hands. A single
Kohli jumps out straightaway and slaps it down the ground for one to long off

ends the over with a boundary, Krunal Pandya! He's turning things around here. Stay with me here - he comes out of the crease and then goes down on a knee to sweep that away into the gap, wide of deep fine leg for four. And that's a fifty for him, a hug of relief with his partner Kohli
slowed down nicely on off this time and a single through covers
fired in towards middle stump, he gets some bat just in time to steer it to off. It came in dangerously with the arm
short and flat on leg, and nudged to long on for one
oh, really wide. Way outside off and it's a wide for sure
from wide of the crease towards off stump, punches it through covers for one
starts well outside leg, short of length so that Krunal doesn't sweep it for six, but he sweeps into the ground behind square for one
into the pads and whipped away for one more on the leg side
on the back foot for the wrong'un and he punches to long off
shorter on the stumps and he works that one down to long on for one
Krunal is batting like a different man now. After all those struggles he has smoked that overpitched delivery so well with the turn, over the covers for a cracking six
pretty wide outside off, swats it down to long off for one
turning to leg from middle, Kohli goes back and clips it square for two in the gap
he wants to finish the over with a boundary, smashes that full ball along the ground though the overs but Starc gets to it from long off and keeps it to two
low full toss on middle and he taps it back, Mukesh gets a hand to it after it falls just short

and on the other side now, two in two! Short of length on off, he hangs back and lofts that straight down the ground with a nice follow through, packing some power into that without moving much and gets six
there comes the release shot from Krunal! A bouncer down leg, pace on the ball, and he helps it along the way with a late swivel and sends it all the way. Kohli is pumped at the other end!
he wants to scoop it to leg, Mukesh lands it wide outside off and Krunal adjusts to steer it towards off but he can't do much with it. It goes off the bat to short third
short of length and angling into the stumps, worked to leg for an easy single
inside edge onto the knee, Krunal loses his bat and his balance. Doesn't look good at all. He went for the sweep against the turn and only managed an edge
jumps out of the crease, Kuldeep pitches it short and turns it away, Krunal can only tap it back to the bowler
leans into the length ball and finds another single to long on. Will Kudleep bowl a googly to him next?
flat on middle and it's nudged to the leg side for a single
tossed up on middle and he pushes it down to long on this time

on middle and delivered from close to the stumps, he nudges to leg with soft hands and calls for wo immediately. Not a direct hit and Krunal's dive helps him make it in time, gets an applause from Kohli for that running
a wide yorker now, not much pace and Kohli pushes it down to long off. Keeps strike
in the block hole outside off, Kohli is not happy after bunting this back to the bowler. He wanted a single to the covers
115.6kmh, short of length angling towards off, but pace off, and he works this to leg for one
a bouncer on the leg side, Krunal wants to swat it fine on leg but doesn't get much bat on that

whipped away over square leg all the way! Didn't move too much, just used his arms and wrists to move them nicely over the ball for a nice follow through, and the fielder in the deep there could only watch the ball sail over him
uses hard hands to drill that along the ground to long off for one
Tossed up fuller, Kohli drives it out to long-off
Kohli picks up a much needed boundar! Kuldeep errs in length ever so little but it's enough for Kohli to pounce on. Rocks back and hammers it square on the leg side
On a length on off, punched to the off side but can't beat short cover
On a length on off and angling across, Kohli tucks it to the leg side
Tossed full on middle, flicked out through midwicket for a single
Short-ish and wide, Krunal cuts it away past the backward point fielder for a couple
Krunal has very little idea about that short ball on leg. Looks to pull and is beaten by it. He takes a blow to the helmet and the ball bounces to Rahul's left
ON a length outside off, pushed to cover's right for what's a risky single
Banged in short around leg, Krunal looks to pull but it goes off the top edge but lands well short of deep backward square
Kohli taps a length ball towards cover for a single
On a length around middle and going across him, Krunal punchily chips it down to long-on on the bounce
On a length outside off, Kohli authoritatively punches it out in front of deep point. But the fielder is able to keep this down to just a single
Legbreak on a length outside off spinning away, Krunal cuts it out through point and they pick up two. Good running
Legbreak on a length outside off, chopped to cover

Kuldeep immediately wants the review Krunal came down the track and looks to have missed this and gets hit on the back pad. Axar is convinced to review. No bat on that. Impact could be outside off. Yup, ball-tracking confirms that! Krunal survives and DC lose a review
Tossed full outside off, Krunal skips down the crease and blocks it back to the bowler
Floated full outside off, Krunal gets low to slog sweep it but the ball stays under the bat
On a length around off, Kohli goes back and clips it to deep midwicket
Krunal looks to get down and slog it away but can only miscue it through midwicket. They get two, though. Big over from RCB's perspective
Tossed up outside off, he looks to drive and it goes off the inside half towards midwicket
Dropped on a length and it's pulled out to deep midwicket
Hammered back over his head! Over pitched and he clears his front leg and hits it straight back. Lands just short of the rope. And Vipraj has overstepped!
Tucks away this len gth ball to deep midwicket
Kohli looks to rock back and pull away this half-tracker but only gets an inside edge past Rahul. That hit Kohli's leg, onto Rahul's foot and ricocheted towards long leg
On a length on middle, tucked to midwicket
Bumped in short around off, Krunal looks to arch back and ramp but misses. Excellent close to the powerplay from Delhi Capitals

Has he nicked that? Full outside off, swinging away at 142kph, Krunal looks to drive and Rahul immediately goes up in appeal, almost celebrating. There was a sound. They don't review it, and rightly so. Replay shows nothing on UltraEdge
Full outside off, swinging away, Krunal squeezes it to cover
Brute! Bouncer around off at 140kph and Krunal quickly gets his head out of the way
Length ball tucked out to deep square leg
Elegant as you like it! Full around middle and leg and Kohli brings out the straight drive past Krunal at the non-striker's
Clipped to deep square leg's right for a single
Tucked to mid-on's left for a single
Krunal comes down the crease to this length ball to work it leg side but it goes off the leading edge towards point
On a length outside off, driven out to long-off
Full on leg, clipped out to deep square leg
Length ball ankgled across, Krunal tucks it to the bowler's left. There was a chance for a run but they don't risk it

Direct hit! The DC players think Patidar is a goner! Kohli clips it to midwicket and looks to take off, but he has sent Patidar scrambling back. And yep, Patidar is well short! Another run-out involving Kohli. Karun Nair with the throw. He took a good catch earlier, and now he's pulled off another stunning bit of fielding! Kohli took a few steps forward and Patidar was charging down when he's sent back
Full around middle, clipped to deep square leg
Short of good length outside off, Patidar fends at it and gets it to the bowler's right off the inside half
Full outside off, driven to cover
On a length around off, Patidar watchfully defends
Thank you very much, says Patidar. Too full, too straight and Patidar glances it fine on the leg side. No fielder there and it races away
Full outside off, tapped square on the offside. Excellent opening spell from Axar Patel!
Tossed up outside off, Patidar pushes at it and the ball hits high on the bat and lobs up in front. But there's no mid-off so he gets away safely

Chopped on! Axar Patel gets both the RCB left-handers at the top order out! It's a bit short outside off and quicker too, at 99.9kph. DDP looks to cut and gets a massive inside edge onto the stumps! The DC skipper is pumped!
Punches this full ball on leg back to the bowler

What a catch! Bethell looks to pull away this shorter ball and doesn't get a hold of it. Karun Nair has to run in from deep backward square and dives in front and holds on to it. Bethell knew the moment he hit it that he was in trouble, and his debut is just a cameo in the end
Floated full outside off, Kohli eases a drive to long-off
Another flick, this time beating the midwicket fielder to his left A little fuller around off but Bethell clips it in front of square
Shot! Just flicked off the pads! On a length around off and finishing on middle. He stays still and just whips this square!
Full outside off and angling across him, Kohli looks to flick and it goes to deep square leg's left off the inside half as this one swings in. Kohli and Starc have a laugh
And Kohli breaks free! He's had enough of waiting about. Sees this bowled short on leg, backs away and slaps this well over the point fielder. First boundary of the innings
Length ball on middle, blocked back to Starc
Full outside off. Not quite a half-volley and Kohli has to reach out a little to drive to cover
Another full ball driven out to long-off
Length ball whipped out to deep backward square
On a length outside off, pushed back to the bowler
Tossed fuller outside off, driven to long-off
beaten first ball! Floated full outside off and goes on with the angle to beat the inside of the bat as Kohli plays for the turn
On a length around leg, Bethell whips it out to deep square leg off his hips for his first IPL run
